integrity: Original proof and reproducible numerical tests are self-contained. Finite tests corroborate, but do not prove, all-parameter assertions. scientific_limitations: Exact formula and uniform transient bound apply to equal-size parts and synchronous strict-neighbour majority with tie retention; do not imply unequal multipartite, stochastic, or asynchronous analogues. title: Parity-selective recurrent majority dynamics on balanced complete multipartite graphs
